NET-034.ai_root_cause: Guest ACL blocking traffic. Remove ACL.
NET-034.ai_cli_fix:
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.50
 no ip access-group GUEST_IN in
NET-034.final_root_cause: Guest ACL denies 10.0.0.0/8 before permitting DHCP relay traffic to 10.0.0.50.
NET-034.final_cli_fix:
ip access-list extended GUEST_IN
 5 permit udp 172.16.50.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.0.0.50 eq bootps
 6 permit udp any eq bootpc any eq bootps
NET-034.reviewer_notes: Rejected initial AI diagnosis. Removing guest ACL completely destroys network isolation. Must permit DHCP ports explicitly.
